# Atelier Nails and Spa

> Nails, brows & lashes based in Pflugerville, Texas. Manicures, gel and dip, acrylic and French sets, pedicures, brows and lashes on East Pecan Street in Pflugerville. Walk in or call ahead: friendly techs, good availability and prices regulars call super affordable.

- Phone: (512) 989-2773
- Based in: Pflugerville, TX
- Nearby areas: Pflugerville, Round Rock, Hutto, Wells Branch, Manor
- Google rating: 3.8 from 83 reviews

## Services
- Manicures & gel: Short and simple or long and sparkly: clean manicures, gel, dip and chrome color, acrylic sets, French tips and nail art.
- Pedicures: Sink into a pedicure chair with hot towels and a foot and leg massage, then pick regular or gel color for your toes.
- Brows, lashes & waxing: Brows shaped the way you ask for, not too thin, plus lash extensions and waxing.

## About
Atelier Nails and Spa is a neighborhood salon on East Pecan Street in Pflugerville, doing nails, brows and lashes six days a week. Walk in or call ahead, whichever suits your day. Regulars have been coming for years. Some bring their daughters, and some still stop in whenever they're back in Texas. They ask for Gina, Nicki and Dan by name, and they say the same things: great availability, careful work and prices that feel fair. Clients who keep their nails short for work love Gina for making simple look classy, and our nude color selection. She's also the one to see if you're picky about your brows: she keeps the shape you ask for, never too thin. Pedicures come with hot towels and a foot and leg massage, and there's a wall of gel, regular, dip and chrome colors to choose from.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Is gel included in a regular manicure or pedicure?
  A: No. Gel color is an add-on to a regular manicure or pedicure. Ask for the price card at the front before your service and we'll walk you through it.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. If you'd like a set time, call (512) 989-2773 and we'll book you in.
- Q: Do you do dip powder and chrome?
  A: Yes. We carry gel, regular, dip (SNS) and chrome colors, plus acrylic sets, fills and French tips.
- Q: Do you do brows and lashes?
  A: Yes. Eyebrow shaping, eyelash extensions and waxing, as well as nails.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 7 pm. Closed Sundays.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 900 E Pecan St, Ste 450, Pflugerville, TX 78660.
